messages.meaning: Generic enabled/current state, not a grammatical description of a person.
Heading for keeping the desktop process active after its main window is hidden; this is not an operating-system service.
Opt-in checkbox that changes a normal window close into hiding the window while the process continues.
Opt-in checkbox that starts the app hidden when the current operating-system user signs in.
Native menu-bar or system-tray command that restores and focuses the Filament Manager window.
Native menu-bar or system-tray command that fully stops Filament Manager; distinguish it from merely closing or hiding the window.
macOS guidance shown when launch at login cannot use an app running from a disk image or App Translocation path; Applications is the localized system Applications folder name.
The physical spool has no usable filament remaining; it is not an empty printer slot.
The user cannot currently locate the physical spool. It has not been deleted.
A spool owned by someone else and temporarily held by the user; opposite of loaned out.
Compact table heading for filament weight when a spool was loaned out, measured in grams.
Estimated usable filament still wound on the spool, excluding the empty-spool weight.
Tare weight of the empty physical spool, subtracted from measured total weight.
A spool owned by the user that has been lent to another person.
Compact loan-table heading for outgoing filament weight in grams.
Total filament consumed by tracked jobs on this printer, not elapsed printer time.
One material position in an AMS, MMU, external holder, or toolhead group.
A printer toolhead/extruder material position; do not translate as a hand tool.
Label for the timestamp of the latest live telemetry update from the printer; live means real-time data, not a broadcast or a living object.
Explains that the displayed remaining-filament value comes from the AMS for the exact RFID-matched roll and is an estimate, not a physical scale measurement.
Total physical roll weight calculated as estimated remaining filament plus the empty-spool tare weight.
Button that explicitly updates the matched inventory roll from the currently displayed AMS estimate; it does not merely refresh telemetry.
Success confirmation that the inventory roll weight was updated from the current AMS estimate.
Error shown when the AMS estimate or exact RFID roll match changed before acceptance; the user must reopen the weight dialog and retry.
AMS-reported nominal filament weight that represents 100% and is used as the basis for calculating remaining grams; it excludes empty-spool tare weight.
Estimated remaining filament reported by the AMS for a matched roll; this is not a price estimate or a physical scale measurement.
Filament Manager's trusted-LAN browser interface. Companion is a product feature name, not a person.
Register stock owned by somebody else and currently held by the user.
The outbound loan has not yet been returned.
A printer material slot has no assigned spool; this is not the empty-spool inventory status.
One load position in an AMS, MMU, external holder, or toolhead group.
A printer toolhead/extruder material position; do not translate as a hand tool.
Heading for the current ownership/loan record associated with the selected spool.
Tare weight of the empty physical spool, not zero remaining filament.
Usage/history source recorded from radio-frequency spool identity. Keep the acronym RFID.
Weight-history source shown after the user accepts an estimate from Bambu Lab's Automatic Material System. Keep the acronym AMS and do not imply a physical scale measurement.
Error shown when the AMS estimate or exact RFID roll match changed before acceptance; the user must reopen the weight dialog and retry.
Compact label for Bambu Lab's Automatic Material System. Keep the product acronym AMS.
